title: FlexUI Revived
description: The FlexUI themes (Fantasy, Sci-Fi, Stone and Classic FantasyUI) rebuilt for Foundry v13's interface: themed sidebar tabs and panel, parchment chat, folders as buttons, scene controls, navigation, hotbar and players list. Switches live without reloads, lets the GM set a table default with per-player choice, and per-area toggles for working alongside other UI modules. Ships no artwork: uses the original FlexUI's images from an installed copy, your own folder, or CSS textures. Based on FlexUI by iotech.
